brand_identity.name: RE·PLATE
brand_identity.logo_style: Wordmark RE·PLATE with vibrant orange emblem dot / badge (#EF5A28)
brand_identity.visual_tone: Near-black operational dark theme, precision monospace data metrics, high contrast burnt orange accents, sharp 1px card borders, zero fluff.

typography.micro_labels: UPPERCASE monospace with tracking-[0.2em] or tracking-[0.25em], font-mono, text-[10px] or text-xs text-zinc-400

layout_and_navigation.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar with collapsable operational navigation, RE·PLATE logo header, outlet switcher, user context, and status pills.
layout_and_navigation.topbar: Sticky header with quick search, live scale connection status badge, active outlet selector, notification bell, and mobile drawer toggle.
layout_and_navigation.grid_strategy: High Density Grid (MODE B) with gap-4 md:gap-6, stretch alignment, subtle 1px border dividers.

modules.label: Dashboard
modules.description: KPI summary stats (Total Value ₹, Stock In/Out/Waste, Low Stock Count, Device Online Count), Live movements feed, Low stock alert feed, Weighing events feed, Edge device status widget.

modules.label: Products / SKU Master
modules.description: Full SKU table, barcode/RFID map, unit weights, minimum stock thresholds, yield ratios, and add/edit SKU dialog.

modules.label: Inventory
modules.description: Current on-hand stock quantities, valuation (₹), storage location breakdown (Cold Room, Dry Store, Prep), and reorder action buttons.

modules.label: Inventory Movements
modules.description: Audit ledger of stock receipts, transfers, waste logs, and auto-deductions with date/type/outlet filters.

modules.label: Devices
modules.description: Edge scale controllers, CCTV camera AI nodes, status logs, battery/signal levels, Web Bluetooth link generator, and device pairing setup.

modules.label: Weighing Events
modules.description: Real-time stream of weight recordings from edge scale app (SKU, gross/tare/net weight, operator, timestamp, stability status).

modules.label: Outlets
modules.description: Multi-location restaurant management (e.g. One N Only Anand, Sambharwala, Spice Garden), location settings, operational stats.

modules.label: Users & Roles
modules.description: Staff access matrix (Owner, Ops Manager, Kitchen Chef, Edge Controller operator).

modules.label: Edge Device App (Mobile Controller)
modules.description: Dedicated mobile-first controller interface with 3 tabs: 1. Device Status & Pairing (Web Bluetooth), 2. Live Weighing (Big weight display, STABLE indicator, SKU selector, TARE & SEND buttons), 3. Recent Events Feed.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Strictly follow RE-PLATE visual identity from re-plate.in: near-black charcoal background (#0B0B0C), vibrant orange accents (#EF5A28), uppercase wide-tracked monospace micro-labels.
Display all monetary figures in Indian Rupees (₹) and weights in KG / G with 3 decimal precision (e.g., 3.250 KG).
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows, and status badges include proper data-testid attributes.
Include both the main Web Dashboard views and the Mobile Edge Device Controller view with Web Bluetooth scale connectivity simulation.
DO NOT use generic bright white backgrounds or default purple AI gradients.
